newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Sinopec cuts investment in fixed assets.
newsitem.headline: China's Sinopec cuts investment in fixed assets.

text.p: The China National Petrochemical Corp's (Sinopec) investment in fixed assets would decline by 15 percent in 1997, officials said on Tuesday.

Investment in fixed assets would account for 50 percent of the company's total investment this year while the remaining 50 percent would be spent on upgrading technology, up 15 percent from 1996, a Sinopec official said by telephone.
The investment would be focused on new projects, he said but gave no further details.
